messages:
Marcos: quick sync — we need a concrete telemetry + policy prototype for fast failover of resident-region writes. preserve residency and avoid split-brain.

Olivia: top-level idea: require explicit tenant consent + control-plane health + replication lag threshold. auto-failover only when consent set and lag under threshold.

Devin: clarify the lag signal: per-tenant apply latency vs WAL ack. promotion safety differs.

Marcos: prefer kv_replication_lag_ms (apply-to-commit index). WAL ack is too noisy with async write buffering.

Kai: export kv_replication_lag_ms per tenant+region with p50/p95/p99. also export last_write_region and last_write_ts per tenant.

sre-bot: alert: eu-west-1 packet loss spike 6.7% at 14:03 UTC — tail write latency rising.

Anna: compliance reminder: cannot flip EU-resident tenant writes to non-EU unless tenant opted in. policy must enforce resident_region.

Marcos: proposed tenant config: resident_region, allow_cross_region_failover (bool default false), failover_replication_lag_ms (default 500), max_auto_failover_qps (default 50).

Signals required: region_controlplane_healthy{region}, kv_replication_lag_ms{tenant,region}, last_write_region{tenant}, probe_connectivity_ok{region}.

Two-stage automated protocol sketch: detect -> preprobe (warm candidate region) -> verify (lag < threshold && probe ok) -> freeze-window (~50-200ms) to drain inflight -> switch route atomically -> post-check audit sweep.

Olivia: client hint headers for explicit consent: X-Redwood-Resident-Region and X-Redwood-Allow-Cross-Region-Failover.

Devin: worried about freeze-window at high QPS. could we rely on idempotent writes + retries? or only auto-failover low-QPS tenants?

Kai: gate auto-failover by max_auto_failover_qps. above that require ops approval.

Anna: audit requirement — when cross-region promotion happens for resident tenants, record justification + metric snapshot, retain 1y.

Priya: ops note — telemetry ingestion must be <1s for decisioning; some pipelines are ~3s now. need faster exporter.

Marcos: action items: Kai to prototype per-tenant lag exporter (due Fri); Olivia to draft RFC/policy (Tue); Devin to run freeze-window sims at multiple QPS (Wed); Anna to confirm compliance language (Thu EOD).

Olivia: conservative defaults: allow_cross_region_failover=false; manual ops for EU->non-EU unless explicit opt-in.

Priya: I made a Grafana dashboard proto "region-failover-probe" with kv_replication_lag_ms panel: https://grafana.redwood/example

deploy-bot: canary deploy staging/region-probe-exporter succeeded (2026-03-22T15:12Z).

Marcos: saving notes for RFC follow-up. will include state machine + observability contract. propose operator-override TTL and forced-revert playbook appendix.

Anna: compliance ok with conservative approach.

Marcos: thanks, closing this sync — will ping when RFC is filed. :thumbsup:
